name: signature-pad
title: Signature Pad
description: Draw a signature and save it
usage: <SignaturePad onSave={png => { const link = document.createElement("a"); link.download = "signature.png"; link.href = png; link.click(); }} />
useCases: At equipment pickup, the recipient signs with a finger. The app attaches the resulting PNG to the pickup record.
In a greeting card editor, an author adds a handwritten autograph, undoes a stray stroke and saves the drawing.
task: Draw a signature and save it
behavior: onSave receives the PNG as a data URL. Download it or convert it to a file for upload.
